items.author: Trump
items.text: RT @realDonaldTrumpThe only reason that communities throughout the U.S.A. should not want Data Centers is if they want to end up being backwards and poor. If they want to be successful and rich, with far lower taxes and jobs all over the place, let Data Reign. The good news is that there are plenty of other places that want them. If we kill the Golden Goose, you will only have yourselves to blame. China could not be happier with this anti Data Center movement. Actually, they can’t believe it is happening! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump发文力挺数据中心建设，称反数据中心运动令中国开心，相关概念受益。

items.author: Trump
items.text: President Trump is the Greatest JOBS President in American History. He works tirelessly every day to create millions of high-paying Jobs, drive Trillions of Dollars in Investment, and reinvigorate our Economy. Just this week, President Trump and the Prime Minister of Bangladesh made another incredible Deal, with Bangladesh committing to spend Billions of Dollars to buy more Boeing Aircraft, significantly increasing their initial order. Our President is Making America, and our partners, Great Again!
items.summary_cn: 白宫力推Trump就业成就，称孟加拉国承诺加购数十亿美元波音飞机，航天链情绪利好(含未上市Boeing)。

items.text: Congratulations to NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman, and the Great Patriots at NASA, on a successful launch. This is THE GOLDEN AGE OF AMERICA! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump祝贺NASA及Isaacman成功发射，称'美国黄金时代'，航天主题情绪利好。

items.text: Trump’s historic oil deal with Venezuela realigns global energy and puts OPEC, Canada on notice: https://justthenews.com/government/white-house/trump-announces-massive-oil-deal-venezuela
items.summary_cn: Trump与委内瑞拉达成'历史性石油协议'，重塑全球能源格局并警告OPEC与加拿大。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Kharg Island being blown to smithereens!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump称Kharg岛(伊朗主要石油出口枢纽)被炸毁，暗示中东原油供给受冲击。

items.author: Trump
items.text: One of the things I am going to do with the Venezuelan Oil is fill up the Strategic National Reserves which, because of Sleepy Joe Biden, has been virtually emptied. The “topping out” process will begin very shortly, and is a Gift from Venezuela to the People of the United States. Thank you! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump称将用委内瑞拉石油补充战略石油储备(SPR)，影响油价与OPEC格局。

items.author: Musk
items.text: GE Vernova Stock Drops. Is SpaceX Coming for Them Too?
items.summary_cn: GE Vernova股价下跌，市场担忧SpaceX进军燃气轮机对其构成竞争威胁。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s Grok can basically control anything in your Tesla now
items.summary_cn: Musk称Grok可基本控制Tesla任何功能，强化Tesla AI/智能驾驶叙事。

items.author: Trump
items.text: When I announced that I was running in the 2024 Presidential Election, right at the beginning, Ford was getting ready to close their Big Factory, in Detroit. Then, because I was leading in the Polls, they figured they would leave it open a little longer to see what happened. Now it’s running 24/7, and it’s one of the most profitable Car Plants in the World! There are many other examples, for both Ford, General Motors, and others. I’ve revived, and indeed saved, the Automobile Business in our America. That’s because of what I’ve done with TARIFFS. One of the Worst Abusers is Canada. I don’t wan
items.summary_cn: Trump宣称关税拯救了底特律福特工厂，F/GM受益，加拿大是'最严重滥用者'。

items.author: Trump
items.text: For many years, the USA has been losing more than 60 Billion Dollars a year with Canada. Why??? Our long ago stolen businesses are now coming back to America in order to avoid paying tariffs. They are lining up, just like the rest of the World!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump称美国与加拿大贸易逆差600亿美元/年，制造业回流美国以规避关税。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Let all Canadian Companies that are doing business with America move to the United States, immediately. Many of them are Companies that moved out years ago due to stupid U.S. Leadership. When you move back, there are no TARIFFS! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump敦促在美经营的加拿大公司立即迁回美国，承诺回流无关税。

items.summary_cn: Musk称Tesla FSD即将能躲避坑洞(此前2019年已说过)，老话题迭代，关注兑现度。
